Meta.title: Patrik Sjerén — Design and code
Meta.description: UI/UX designer and frontend developer in Malmö, Sweden. 25 years of experience, 15 of them agency-side.

Home.introOne: I am a UI/UX designer and frontend developer in Malmö, Sweden, with 25 years of experience, 15 of them agency-side. The same person designs and builds, from first draft to deployed site.
Home.introTwo: Framework agnostic, which mostly means I have no ego invested in the stack. The site has to be maintainable after I leave — that decides more than what is fun to build right now.
Home.aboutHeadline: House and techno first, HTML later. Same job, really: find the structure and take out everything that is not holding it up.
Home.aboutBody: I have built in Wordpress, Laravel, Vue, Nuxt and Next. None of them is the answer to everything, and anyone who says otherwise has only tried one. It took about twenty years to stop having opinions about it.
Home.aboutCardDesignBody: Logotypes, interfaces, print. I have done vehicle wraps and design systems in the same career, and they are more alike than they sound.
Home.aboutCardDevBody: I build scalable sites from scratch that fit the design cleanly. The platform is chosen to match the complexity of the project.
Home.aboutCardFreeBody: In the woods or on the beach with Chaka, my Jack Russell. Or working on a new music track — that is where my roots are.

About.title: About — Patrik Sjerén
About.description: Thirty-seven years, two tracks. Frontend developer and designer in Malmö, with roots in club music.
About.heroBody: I have been at this since 1989 — though the first years were about sound, not pixels. Both tracks run through everything I do, so here they share a line.
About.profileOne: I design and I build. Fifteen of my twenty-five years in the trade were spent agency-side — teams, deadlines and clients who change their minds late.
About.profileTwo: I have worked in teams at Webzoo and First Vision, and as a consultant through Get a Qlue at Svensk Cater, where I documented a stack of .NET, Umbraco, Next and Vue and mapped the way forward. Clients have ranged from a tyre shop in Malmö to AUMA's electric actuators.
About.profileThree: I come from print as much as from the web. Logotypes, brochures and vehicle wraps still shape how I look at type and spacing, even when the result is a screen.
About.profileFour: I am looking for both contract work and a permanent role. Preferably somewhere design and code do not sit in separate rooms.
